commit_token.description: From a dry run. Single-use and idempotent: resending after a network failure replays the recorded outcome.

dry_run.description: Default true: preview affected records and return a commit_token. Explicit false applies immediately; prefer preview then commit_token for agent workflows.

op.description: sources.* use where.source or where.collection, never entry filters. entries.* use the full where predicate. collections.rename/delete select one where.collection; collections.create uses set.name.

collection.description: Required for sources.move: destination collection id or name.

name.description: Required for collections.create and collections.rename: the collection name.

title.description: Required for sources.rename: the new source title.

where.description: Entry selection predicate: fields AND together; omit a field to not filter on it. Source queries/mutations accept only collection and source; use query having for source-health filters.

classification.description: The Collection filter's binary delivery decision and optional underlying assessment. Requires exactly one Collection.

items.description: A collection id or its exact name.

discovered_after.description: When smry first saw the entry. Backfill makes old posts look new here, so use it for diffs, not for "what's new". Relative window ("7d", "36h", "45m", "2w"), "now", or ISO date.

match.description: Case-insensitive text match over title and summary. "a OR b" matches either.

published_after.description: When the source published the entry (entries with no publish date are excluded; use top-level since to include them). Relative window ("7d", "36h", "45m", "2w"), "now", or ISO date.

items.description: A source id (from any v2 response) or its title. Reads also accept a fragment that matches exactly one title.

unread.description: true = only unread entries, false = only read entries.
